title: anim.intro/1
description: data/anim/intro.json: the opening's tuning (render/anim/anim_fighter.gd, _intro_layer; docs/architecture/intro-phase.md; pose-pipeline.md section 9.19). tense_lead and tense_ramp: the tension pose comes in over tense_ramp seconds, finishing tense_lead seconds before the end of the staredown. beats: for a shape key, the staredown's one small beat: a sequence of data/anim/waves/intro1.sequences.json and when it starts (seconds after the staredown starts). Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references (every beat shape key is in ragdoll_motion.json shapes; every seq is in intro1.sequences.json) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (intro-shape, intro-seq).

tense_lead.description: Seconds before the end of the staredown at which the tension pose is complete.

tense_ramp.description: Seconds the tension pose takes to come in.

beats.description: Shape key to its one small beat.
